summary: First public release: a much larger library, a faster explorer and gradient paint across every package.
notes: Hundreds of new icons across every category, plus new Business, Household, Accessibility and AI categories.
Gradient fills via the gradient prop in React, Vue and Svelte, and gradientId/toSvg options in @ikions/icons.
The explorer loads the catalog once and renders incrementally, so it stays fast with thousands of icons.
Duplicate detection and alias checks keep every icon distinct and every name unique.

summary: Foundation release: the Ikions design language, the first original icon set in Outline and Filled, and packages for React, Vue, Svelte and plain SVG.
notes: Original 24 × 24 icon grid with a 1.75 outline stroke and independently drawn filled variants.
Website with icon explorer, search, category browsing, detail pages, copy and download (SVG, PNG, ZIP, sprite).
Automated SVG validation, optimisation and code generation from a single source per variant.
